accounts_owner.name: accounts_owner
accounts_owner.value: ("accounts"."kind" = 'system') = ("accounts"."customer_id" IS NULL AND "accounts"."system_key" IS NOT NULL)

decisions_agent_uses_rule.name: decisions_agent_uses_rule
decisions_agent_uses_rule.value: "decisions"."actor" = 'customer' OR "decisions"."rule_id" IS NOT NULL OR "decisions"."mission_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("decisions"."result" IN ('Reported', 'Stopped', 'Failed') AND "decisions"."ledger_transaction_id" IS NULL)

findings_sweep_names_paycheck_and_rule.name: findings_sweep_names_paycheck_and_rule
findings_sweep_names_paycheck_and_rule.value: "findings"."kind" <> 'sweep' OR ("findings"."ledger_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "findings"."rule_id" IS NOT NULL)

findings_subscription_price.name: findings_subscription_price
findings_subscription_price.value: ("findings"."subscription_merchant" IS NOT NULL AND "findings"."subscription_price_cents" IS NOT NULL) = ("findings"."kind" = 'subscription_price_rise')
